report_level_evaluation.results: Demonstrates implementation feasibility and detailed semantic/scoping rules;no primary user-study or runtime/accuracy benchmark; limits: Earlier ViziQuer reports/examples are cited,but no new participant sample here. Translation order limits clause-order control;named-graph specification remains work in progress.; The report supports mostSPARQL1.1SELECT constructs,not a claim of completeSPARQL language support.; DirectSQL translation and richer named-graph/clause-order controls are future work.; Configured schema information contributes to name resolution and translation;do not describe this implementation as schema-free.
